text:
IncidentBot: 🚨 Release rollout alert: high 5xx rate from embeddings-service in eu-west-2 during staged rollout (release: r2025-03-17-2). PagerDuty triggered (PD#INC-8421).
PagerBot: PagerDuty: page fired -> https://pagerduty.example/INC-8421 (on-call: Priya). Escalation policy: SRE pager -> eng-oncall.
Priya: acked. heading in. grabbing context.
Alex: thx. i'm watching dashboards (latency p95 + errors). Hitting ~7% 5xx on the eu-west split, traffic fraction ~20% for this rollout.
Dan: checking logs — a lot of gRPC 503s from quant-kernel-worker with "kv cache miss" followed by SegFault-like stacktraces. repro trace id: ea3f2d.
Emily: that quant-kernel change landed in the model-runtime image tag `model-runtime:quant-v3`. New default quant path may be incompatible with longer prompt lengths for embeddings.
Marta: customer-impact: internal SLO alerting shows two top customers in EU getting failed embedding calls (10-20% request failures), some product flows blocked. We should mark as "customer impacting" for comms.
Priya: agree. I'm oncall lead. Dan/Emily, can you validate whether diverting traffic to previous variant (quant-v2) resolves 5xx quickly?
Dan: starting quick traffic diversion. Plan: update rollout routing to fallback variant `embed-stable:v202502`. Command:
```
# divert rollout traffic in staging -> prod routing service
redwood routing set-variant --service embeddings-service --region eu-west-2 \
  --from release:r2025-03-17-2 --to variant:embed-stable:v202502 --fraction 1.0
```
Priya: +1, carry out and confirm. Also initiate rollback runbook if diversion doesn't stop errors.
OpsBot: routing change in progress... applying weights -> 100% to embed-stable:v202502 in eu-west-2.
Alex: after diversion, 5xx rate dropping in the last 30s. p95 latency back to baseline.
IncidentBot: Alert suppressed for INC-8421 (automatic suppression after diversion).
Emily: From local repro, the quant-v3 kernel uses an AVX flag path that triggers memory corruption on the older GPU nodes in eu-west-2. That's consistent with segfaults. We'll need a kernel patch or node pool upgrade.
Marta: Customer comms: notify CustomerOps for impacted tenants in EU, draft message saying we observed elevated failures during a staged rollout, diverted traffic, and rolling back to stable.
Liam: I've opened a rollback job for full release rollback across regions (safety-checks passed). Command executed: `redwood release rollback --release r2025-03-17-2 --confirm --regions eu-west-2`.
OpsBot: rollback job queued -> started. Progress: 12% -> 57% -> 100%.
Alex: Post-rollback telemetry looks clean. 5xx rates at baseline, error traces for ea3f2d are no longer appearing.
Priya: good. marking incident as mitigated. We'll keep monitoring for 30m for any recurrence.
Dan: I'll open a bug for quant-kernel fallback + add unit tests for long prompt handling. Tagging: @eng-ml, @eng-runtime.
Emily: work item: reproduce on eu-west-2 old nodes and test kernel patch. Also coordinate with infra to consider node pool refresh.
Marta: created customer tickets and pushed a short message to impacted customers. CustomerOps taking ownership for external comms.
Priya: handing off to follow-up oncall (Marta) for postmortem and communication. Oncall notes: summary for postmortem, attach traces and rollout diff, timeline.
Marta: ack handoff. I'll schedule a postmortem, include root cause (quant kernel path + incompatible GPU microarchitecture), mitigation (rollback & routing diversion), and action items (kernel patch, node pool plan, improved canary gate for quant-path changes).
Priya: thanks team. Closing active paging. If anyone sees new alerts, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Alex: adding a short runbook tweak: add a canary check that runs long prompt embedding tests for quant paths before promotion.
Dan: noted. will add to runbook and PR.
Priya: thread closed — last check at 30m looks stable. We'll postmortem tomorrow.
Marta: closing handoff; tagging incident for postmortem doc creation.
